controller.description: Configuration for the CSI controller. clusterTagIsolation backfill and enforce require non-empty clusterName and clusterTagKey

adaptiveRetryMode.description: Control if adaptive retry mode will be used to more heavily client side rate limit EFS API requests

affinity.description: Affinity scheduling rules for the CSI controller service Deployment

clusterName.description: Name of the EKS cluster. With clusterTagKey, every access point the controller creates is tagged <clusterTagKey>=<clusterName>. The tag-based IAM policies require the EKS cluster name.

clusterTagIsolation.description: Cluster tag isolation state. disable: no isolation. backfill: tag existing access points this cluster owns, at startup and every hour. enforce: ignore access points that lack this cluster's tag. backfill and enforce require non-empty clusterName and clusterTagKey, and an IAM policy that matches the state.

clusterTagKey.description: Tag key whose value is clusterName. With clusterName, it is added to every access point the controller creates. The tag-based IAM policies use eks:eks-cluster-name. Cannot be efs.csi.aws.com/cluster or start with aws:. Not allowed by AmazonEFSCSIDriverPolicy.

deleteAccessPointRootDir.description: For dynamic provisioning, control whether the access point directory is deleted on unmount

enableMetrics.description: Enable the Prometheus metrics endpoint on the controller. When true, the driver exposes metrics on port 3301 and the csi-provisioner sidecar on port 3302.

enablePrometheusAnnotations.description: Add prometheus.io scrape annotations to the controller pod when metrics are enabled.

livenessProbe.description: Liveness probe configuration for the CSI controller container

logLevel.description: The log level of the driver's controller service

nodeSelector.description: The nodeSelector Schema for the CSI controller service Deployment

podAnnotations.description: The podAnnotations Schema for the CSI controller service Deployment

podDisruptionBudget.description: PodDisruptionBudget configuration for the CSI controller Deployment. Set only one of minAvailable and maxUnavailable; if neither is set, minAvailable defaults to 1

enabled.description: The option to enable a managed PodDisruptionBudget for the controller

maxUnavailable.description: maxUnavailable value for the managed PDB, can be either string or integer; if it's a string, it should end with %

minAvailable.description: minAvailable value for the managed PDB, can be either string or integer; if it's a string, it should end with %

unhealthyPodEvictionPolicy.description: Defines the criteria for when unhealthy pods should be considered for eviction

podLabels.description: The podLabels Schema for the CSI controller service Deployment

priorityClassName.description: Priority class name for the CSI controller pods, influencing scheduling and preemption order

readinessProbe.description: Readiness probe configuration for the CSI controller container

replicaCount.description: The number of replicas for the CSI controller service Deployment

resources.description: Resource requests/limits of the controller pod

rollingUpdate.description: Rolling update configuration for the CSI controller service Deployment strategy

serviceAccount.description: Service account configuration for the CSI controller

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the controller service account (e.g., eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn for IRSA)

serviceMonitor.description: Controls creation of a Prometheus Operator ServiceMonitor resource. Requires the Prometheus Operator CRDs to be installed.

enabled.description: The option to create a ServiceMonitor for the controller metrics endpoint

startupProbe.description: Startup probe configuration for the CSI controller container

timeout.description: Timeout for Create/DeleteVolume calls to Controller

tolerations.title: The tolerations Schema for the CSI controller service Deployment

topologySpreadConstraints.description: Topology spread constraints for the controller pod

volumeMounts.description: Add additional volume mounts on the controller

volumes.description: Add additional volumes to be mounted onto the controller

workerThreads.description: Number of concurrent threads controller will handle at once

debugLogs.description: Set klog verbosity to level 5 and enable debug logging in efs-utils.

efsCloudWatchLogEnabled.description: Enable CloudWatch logging for EFS in efs-utils.conf.

efsUtilsConfOverrides.description: Comma-separated section:key=value pairs to override settings in efs-utils.conf. For example, --efs-utils-conf-overrides=mount-watchdog:stunnel_health_check_interval_min=1. If a key already exists in the specified section it is updated in place; otherwise it is appended to that section. These overrides take precedence over other flags that control the same config (e.g., efs-cloudwatch-log-enabled). Invalid entries (missing : or =) cause the driver to return an error on startup.

forceUnmountAfterTimeout.description: Enable force unmount if normal unmount times out during NodeUnpublishVolume unmount

livenessProbe.description: Liveness probe configuration for the CSI node container

logLevel.description: The log level of the driver's node service

maxInflightMountCalls.description: New NodePublishVolume operation will be blocked if maximum number of inflight calls is reached. If maxInflightMountCallsOptIn is true, it has to be set to a positive value.

maxInflightMountCallsOptIn.description: Opt in to use max inflight mount calls limit.

nodeSelector.description: The nodeSelector Schema for the CSI node service Dameonset

podAnnotations.description: The podAnnotations Schema for the CSI node service Dameonset

podLabels.description: The podLabels Schema for the CSI node service DaemonSet

priorityClassName.description: Priority class name for the CSI node pods, influencing scheduling and preemption order

readinessProbe.description: Readiness probe configuration for the CSI node container

resources.description: Resource requests/limits of the node DaemonSet

rollingUpdate.description: Rolling update configuration for the CSI node service DaemonSet updateStrategy

s3filesCloudWatchLogEnabled.description: Enable CloudWatch logging for S3Files in s3files-utils.conf.

s3filesCloudWatchMetricsEnabled.description: Enable CloudWatch metrics emission for S3 files in s3files-utils.conf.

s3filesUtilsConfOverrides.description: Comma-separated section:key=value pairs to override settings in s3files-utils.conf. Follows the same format and validation rules as efs-utils-conf-overrides. These overrides take precedence over other flags that control the same config (e.g., s3files-cloudwatch-log-enabled, s3files-cloudwatch-metrics-enabled).

serviceAccount.description: Service account configuration for the CSI node DaemonSet

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the node service account (e.g., eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn for a dedicated node IRSA role)

startupProbe.description: Startup probe configuration for the CSI node container

tolerations.title: The tolerations Schema for the CSI node service Deployment

unmountTimeout.description: Timeout for unmounting a volume during NodeUnpublishVolume when forceUnmountAfterTimeout is true. If the timeout is reached, the volume will be forcibly unmounted. The default value is 30 seconds.

volMetricsOptIn.description: Control whether or not to expose CSI volume usage metrics

volumeAttachLimit.description: Maximum number of volumes that can be attached to a node. If volumeAttachLimitOptIn is true, it has to be set to a positive value.

volumeAttachLimitOptIn.description: Opt in to use volume attach limit.

sidecars.description: Resource configuration for sidecar containers shared across controller and node pods

csiProvisioner.description: Configuration for the csi-provisioner sidecar container

resources.description: Resource requests/limits for the csi-provisioner sidecar

livenessProbe.description: Configuration for the liveness-probe sidecar container

resources.description: Resource requests/limits for the liveness-probe sidecar

nodeDriverRegistrar.description: Configuration for the csi-node-driver-registrar sidecar container

resources.description: Resource requests/limits for the csi-node-driver-registrar sidecar

useFIPS.description: Assert whether or not the driver uses FIPS enabled endpoints
